title: Deposit product version, v1
description: Definition of a version of a deposit product (ADR-0008). Amounts are integers in minor units of the product currency, written without a decimal point. No field admits null and no key is repeated. Besides this schema, the parser checks what a schema cannot express: the currency is supported, the tiers go up from 0, fee codes are unique and an exempt_rule names a rule.

day_count.description: Day count convention of the interest; ACT/ACT is the ISDA one.

rate_tiers.description: Effective annual rate by balance slab: each tier applies from its from_units up to the next tier's. The first starts at 0 and each one starts above the previous one.

capitalization_frequency.description: How often the accrued interest is posted to the account.

date_convention.description: How a capitalization date that falls on a non-business day is moved.

dormancy_days.description: Days without customer activity after which an active account is dormant.

allowed_kyc.description: KYC statuses of the party with which an account can be opened.

gmf_exempt_eligible.description: Whether an account of the product can be marked exempt from the GMF.

rules.description: Named CEL predicates, such as fee exemptions.

rate_ea.description: Effective annual rate as a fraction from 0 to 1 with up to 8 decimals: 0.0425 is 4.25 %.

exempt_rule.description: Name of the rule that, when satisfied, exempts the operation from the fee.

limits.description: Limits of the product; an absent one does not apply. daily_debits and monthly_debits add up the debits of the day and of the month.

limit.description: An amount in minor units or a number of SMMLV (monthly minimum wages), converted with the market parameter in force.

accounts.description: Codes of the internal ledger accounts the product posts against.
